lead: A scroll container with a custom scrollbar: scrolling itself is native, while the scrollbar (track and thumb) is drawn by the theme style. There is no height prop: put it in a parent with a height and it fills the parent and scrolls inside it.

both.title: Both
both.line: A wide line of text that overflows both ways — {n}

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `scroll-area.css`: the thumb uses 25% of the foreground colour and darkens on hover.
styling.root: The outer box (clips the content) and the viewport that actually scrolls
styling.scrollbar: The scrollbar and its thumb; `data-orientation` tells the direction, and Base UI writes the thumb size as CSS variables
styling.corner: The bottom-right corner when both scrollbars are shown
styling.states: Written on the scrollbar while hovered or scrolling, so it can fade in
